{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Blouse: straight cut with a soft V-neck, hip length, worn tucked in, ice blue (#cfdcea), silk-blend crepe.
Trousers: high-rise, straight leg, ankle length, deep navy (#263449), wool-blend crepe.
Jacket: single-breasted, slightly shaped, hip length, slate gray (#8a909c), textured wool bouclé.
Coat: single-breasted, knee length, with a notched lapel, charcoal (#4a4f5a), soft wool blend.
Loafers: almond toe, low block heel, burgundy (#5a2a35), smooth leather.
Bag: structured medium tote with top handles, burgundy (#5a2a35), matte leather.
Earrings: small smooth hoops, silver tone (#c0c0c0), polished metal.

This outfit sits in the neat business band: a blouse with trousers, a textured jacket and loafers. The cool blue, navy and slate palette echoes her silver-gray hair and light blue eyes, while the burgundy shoes and bag add a warm, rich accent against her fair, rosy skin. The high-rise straight trousers and the hip-length jacket create a long, clean vertical line, and the tucked blouse keeps the waist neat without clinging. The knee-length coat covers the whole look for autumn mornings and stays in the same quiet color family, so every piece works together. Lipstick is left for her to choose, and the soft blues and burgundy will suit most shades."}
